UserPromptSubmit.description: Injects Wiki files (HOME, RULES, CURRENT_TASK, JUDGE) into Codex prompts as additionalContext.

PreToolUse.description: Intercepts tool invocations; blocks commands matching the denylist (rm -rf, sudo, git reset --hard, etc.).

StopJudge.description: On turn stop, reads last assistant message and writes verdict to Wiki (default: human_review).
